title: The member mega footer writes its index as JSON-LD, keeps the Legal column, and has a side gutter and a smaller gap above it
detail: Design item 2 follow-up (Daniel 2026-10-20, 'double check every item'). The member footer (FqMegaFooter) now writes SiteNavigationElement JSON-LD from the columns it draws, as the public footer does; the Legal column is back in the index grid (the bar's legal row still repeats it so policies are findable with the index shut); the bar, panel and legal row take the desktop gutter instead of 8px; and the space above the footer drops from 96px to 32px. Daniel chose to keep the index closed by default (decision card 2026-10-20), so the closed-by-default test pin is unchanged. The centre column's 160px bottom room is pinned by dock-footer.test.ts and was left alone. No migration. LIVE-1115 (2026-10-20): the index now opens as a centred pop-up; the Legal column stays in its grid and the gutter check reads the new bar. LIVE-1116: the footer is now a bar pinned between the docks; the gutter check reads its phone gutter.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const f=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/shared/mega-footer.tsx','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/shell/members-shell.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/mega-footer.css','utf8');if(!f.includes('siteNavigationSchema(columns)'))bad.push('member footer writes no JSON-LD');if(m.includes(\"c.title !== 'Legal'\"))bad.push('member footer drops the Legal column');if(!c.includes('padding:8px var(--fq-gutter-mobile'))bad.push('footer has no side gutter on a phone');if(/LEGAL_HREFS|title !== .Legal./.test(f))bad.push('member footer drops the Legal column');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1095: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the member footer loses its JSON-LD, drops the Legal column again, or loses its side gutter.
